occurrences.text: He brought me up also out of an horrible pit, out of the miry clay, and set my feet upon a rock, and established my goings.
I sink in deep mire, where there is no standing: I am come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
